svg.title: VII. The Chariot: Hyprkeys
svg.desc: VII. The Chariot, reversed. Software. Powerful and easy to use keyboard utility designed for my favorite Wayland Compositor, Hyprland.. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), And, lo! toward us in a bark comes on an old man, hoary white with eld. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 63. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.

svg.text: Powerful and easy to use keyboard
